name: GEYSERIN_AS_IDLE
meaning: SetAnimState 5 plays anim 1 STAND0 (ATORNA02); state IDLE uses it

name: GEYSERIN_AS_ACTIVE
meaning: 6 plays anim 2 TORNA3 + geyser sound 0x12f; state ACTIVE

name: GEYSERIN_AS_CORKED
meaning: 7 plays anim 0 TOSTAND1 looped; state CORKED

name: GEYSERIN_AS_TRANSIT
meaning: 8 plays anim 4 TORNA4A unless coming from 9; state TRANSIT
